No surprise. 
This restaurant had inconsistent food quality that ebbed and flowed depending on the chef. They were perhaps at their best (food-wise) when Chef Mossin worked there. When he left, food quality suffered. But this inconsistency could have possibly been overlooked.
That said, they were very consistent when it came to service. For as long as I can remember....it consistently sucked!! At one point they did nearly a complete restart with service, but again it was the management that couldn't keep things together.
It was really such a shame. It looked spectacularly cool on the inside with the brick walls and stellar lighting, coupled with a really nice outdoor bar and patio area, but the shoddy and ineffective management killed what should have been a home run. But this wasn't the only restaurant that they couldn't keep going well. 
The locals all knew this, and apparently the Yelpers did too. 
So goodbye Blush.
